entries.title: Psalms 90:1
segments: <<A Prayer of Moses the man of God.>> Lord, thou hast been our dwelling-place In all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 90:2
segments: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever thou  hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

entries.title: Psalms 90:3
segments: Thou turnest man to  destruction, And sayest, Return, ye children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 90:4
segments: For a thousand years in thy sight Are but as yesterday  when it is past, And as a watch in the night.

entries.title: Psalms 90:5
segments: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

entries.title: Psalms 90:6
segments: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

entries.title: Psalms 90:7
segments: For we are consumed in thine anger, And in thy wrath are we troubled.

entries.title: Psalms 90:8
segments: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, Our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 90:9
segments: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: We bring our years to an end as  a sigh.

entries.title: Psalms 90:10
segments: The days of our years are threescore years and ten, Or even by reason of strength fourscore years; Yet is their pride but labor and sorrow; For it is soon gone, and we fly away.

entries.title: Psalms 90:11
segments: Who knoweth the power of thine anger, And thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto thee?

entries.title: Psalms 90:12
segments: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.

entries.title: Psalms 90:13
segments: Return, O Jehovah; how long? And let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

entries.title: Psalms 90:14
segments: Oh satisfy us in the morning with thy lovingkindness, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

entries.title: Psalms 90:15
segments: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, And the years wherein we have seen evil.

entries.title: Psalms 90:16
segments: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, And thy glory upon their children.

entries.title: Psalms 90:17
segments: And let the  favor of the Lord our God be upon us; And establish thou the work of our hands upon us; Yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
